::: {#exm-causal-mask}

#### Masked weights for five characters

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
mask = nn.Transformer.generate_square_subsequent_mask(5)
with torch.no_grad():
    x5 = embed(line[:, :5])
    _, masked_weights = attend(x5, x5, x5, attn_mask=mask)
print(mask)
print(masked_weights[0].numpy().round(2))
```

`nn.Transformer.generate_square_subsequent_mask(5)` builds the [causal mask](#def-causal-mask) for 5 positions,
with $-\infty$ above the diagonal and 0 elsewhere,
and `attn_mask` adds it to the scores.
In the weights for `"First"`,
row 1 puts all its weight on `"F"`,
and every entry above the diagonal is 0.

:::
